export type DataTableLabelOverrides = Partial<
  Omit<DataTableLabels, "operators">
> & { readonly operators?: Partial<DataTableLabels["operators"]> };

  query: "查询",
  reset: "重置",
  expand: "展开",
  collapse: "收起",
  clearFilters: "清空",
  selectAll: "选择本页所有行",
  selectRow: "选择行",

  dragRow: "拖拽调整行顺序",
  resizeColumn: "调整列宽",

  collapseRow: "收起行",

  removeRule: "删除条件",
  matchAll: "满足全部条件",

  rangeStart: "开始",

  any: "全部",

  noOptions: "无选项",

    eq: "等于",
    neq: "不等于",
    contains: "包含",
    startsWith: "开头是",

    gte: "大于等于",
    lt: "小于",
    lte: "小于等于",
    between: "介于",

    notIn: "不属于",

  selected: (count) => `已选 ${count} 项`,
  clearSelection: "取消选择",
  bulkToolbar: (count) => `已选 ${count} 行的批量操作`,
  total: (total) => `共 ${total} 条`,
  pageRows: (count) => `本页 ${count} 条`,
  pageSize: "每页条数",
  firstPage: "首页",
  previousPage: "上一页",
  nextPage: "下一页",
  lastPage: "末页",
  pageNumber: "页码",
};

export function resolveDataTableLabels(
  overrides?: DataTableLabelOverrides,
): DataTableLabels {
  if (!overrides) return dataTableLabels;
  return {
    ...dataTableLabels,
    ...overrides,
    operators: { ...dataTableLabels.operators, ...overrides.operators },
  } as DataTableLabels;
}
